notes: v1.14.527 — DOCK ALIGNMENT + WRENCH ROTATION. Both nav-item rules move from justify-content:center to flex-start, and #rd-exit drops to the same gap:3px and padding:4px 4px its siblings use. EXIT carries a fourth flex child (the hold hint), so centring pushed its icon above the other three; starting every column at the same top puts all four icon boxes on one line. The wrench is re-cut as tools-v4 rotated 40 degrees and fit to 190/256: a 4.5:1 glyph cannot be given presence by scale, and the canvas ceiling was only +13.3%, so it was rotated instead. It now renders 40.1x35.4 at a 54px box, between BUILD 47.7x30.0 and EXIT 33.1x38.0, where flat it was 47.7x10.5. New -v4 filename because overwriting a precached asset in place serves the old bytes from cache. .bicon stays 54x54 with object-fit:contain; all four icons already shared that box, so it was not changed to 44.
